subtitle: Lesson 104 · Transactions, Locking, and Isolation Levels

caption: Only ONE transaction can hold an X lock on this row at a time.

eyebrow: An X lock blocks readers AND writers
code:
-- Session B
SELECT ListPrice FROM Production.Product
WHERE ProductID = 680;  -- BLOCKS

-- Session C
UPDATE Production.Product SET ListPrice = 30.00
WHERE ProductID = 680;  -- ALSO BLOCKS
caption: Unlike a shared lock, X conflicts with everything — even another X.
The longer the transaction stays open, the longer others wait.

code:
SELECT resource_type, request_mode, request_status,
       request_session_id
FROM sys.dm_tran_locks;
-- request_mode = 'X', request_status = 'GRANT' or 'WAIT'
